title: Erlang connection pool
context: Fixed-size pool of database connection processes. checkout/0 hands one idle connection exclusively to the caller or returns {error, empty}; checkin/1 gives it back. If a caller dies while holding a connection, that connection must return to the idle list. The pool server is long-lived and callers check out many times.
code: handle_cast({checkin, Conn}, #{idle := Idle, busy := Busy} = S) ->
Busy1 = maps:filter(fun(_Ref, C) -> C =/= Conn end, Busy),

expected.why: the connection is handed out but left in the idle list, so the next caller gets the same connection
the caller's monitor is never demonitored on checkin, so a long-lived caller accumulates one monitor per checkout
the dead caller's connection is dropped from busy but never put back in idle, so the pool shrinks permanently
